change_reason: The independently authored evaluation contract identified an enumerated parent population, a role omitted from the proposed v1 plan. No scored v1 producer output existed.

parent_population_fields.enumeration: Exact path, bytes, SHA-256, episode count and row count.
parent_population_fields.subset_membership: Per-member identity and statistics agreement for every retained subset member.
parent_population_fields.moments: Pooled mean/std comparison with named tolerance and arithmetic basis.
parent_population_fields.quantiles: Not matched without raw parent rows; bracketed or not_comparable only.
parent_population_fields.intent: Separate supported/rejected/unresolved status; population identity does not prove author intent.

rule_change: A bound parent population is reusable for the scoped invocation even when its moments differ from the retained subset. Recomputing the subset is rejected as a replacement unless a separate current-population obligation is established.
preserved: All v1 source, arithmetic, process, cost and invalid/unresolved separation rules.
The v1 proposal and its timing.
Expected decisions stay outside producer inputs.
